blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte, sibling of Vice President Sara Duterte, is one of the persons subjected to subpoenas issued by the Senate Impeachment Court, as the prosecution seeks to present more witnesses for Article II of the Articles of Impeachment. Presiding Officer and Senator-judge Francis Escudero issued the subpoena for Duterte, Atty. Gerardo del Rosario of the Securities and Exchange Commission, and other individuals at the end of Wednesday’s impeachment trial. “We are in receipt of requests for subpoenas ad testificandum and duces tecum […] The Chair hereby grants the request for subpoena with the following changes: subpoena duces tecum […]... Keep on reading: Sara impeachment trial: Baste Duterte among others to receive subpoena
